implementationNotes:
DEPRECATION PLACEMENT IS PART OF THIS TASK, per the (c) ruling's removal version.

opum-agent ruled the Story alias and its schema file come out at 1.0.0 (lore is 0.8.0; Arc ships in the next minor). The ruling is explicit about WHERE that has to be recorded: "the deprecation belongs in the published `lore instructions` text and the release notes, not only in an ADR" — i.e. where a CONSUMER will actually meet it. This task owns the published-text surface, so it owns that.

Concretely, beyond the 22 Story->Arc text sites already scoped: `lore instructions` must state that Story is a deprecated alias of Arc, that it still resolves, that `.lore/schemas/story.schema.json` is still emitted, and that both are removed at 1.0.0. instructions.ts is 11 of the 22 sites already, so this lands in a file already being edited.

Note the eval consequence recorded on LCLI-552: SKILL.md's description line is the skill TRIGGERING description, so changing Story/Task coupling to Arc/Task coupling changes what the skill matches on. That is what OPAG-277's required eval pass actually tests, and it is a concrete test rather than a ceremony.
